## Notes

### Quick read
- Lauren is a warm, easygoing stay-at-home mom of a blonde baby girl (about 1 year) with a bright, tidy suburban home, and she has the highest GMV of this batch ($1,558, ROAS 1.71) from only 4 approved videos.
- Best next move: get her filming again (nothing since Sep 1) with a talking-to-camera script, since her one yapper-style listicle ran as 3 ads.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- Who she is on camera: mom, brunette with a claw clip, gentle smiley vibe, neutral outfits (beige tee, sage jumpsuit, denim shorts). One daughter, blonde toddler girl around 10 to 14 months, in the Checkered sling. Settings: bright living room with a white sectional and pink kids' play couch, bedroom with a "You will forever be my always" sign, one outdoor sidewalk walk.
- Format: mostly silent lifestyle b-roll set to music with a text overlay, very short (8 to 13s), plus one talking-to-camera listicle (22s). Calm, low energy, soft and sweet. She shows the buckle close up with the Bambora patch, then walks around the house with baby on hip, opens doors, goes upstairs.
- Hooks: "Pretty chic to embrace the Velcro baby life." (text); "My toddler will not let me put her down" (VO); "5 things worth the money as a stay-at-home mom" (listicle counting on her fingers: Costco, Romp and Roll, Bogg Bag, curl cream, then the sling); "Run, don't walk! Bambora's back-to-school sale is too good to miss!" (text).
- What worked: the "5 things worth the money" listicle (edcf0a46) ran as 3 ads and is her best performer; the two "toddler will not let me put her down" house b-roll videos (20694800, 51e4ad26) and the "Velcro baby life" clip (8f0f24f5) each ran as 1 ad. $156 earnings, $1,558 GMV, 26 conversions.
- What got rejected: ca03f10f as a duplicate of 8f0f24f5 (she wanted the other song because the first said "baby boy"); an image (92c63b16, we only run video); 5b57cbdf with no comment and no frame sheet (could not be read, likely also a non-video); 1d8e55d5 (3s outdoor walk) for being too short.
- Safety and checklist issues seen:
  - 20694800 and 51e4ad26: shots of her going up the stairs with baby in the sling. The checklist says not to film on stairs, so avoid that in new videos even though both ran.
  - edcf0a46: while counting on her fingers her other arm is loosely around the toddler and the girl's legs hang straight down; seat under the bottom is not clearly shown.
  - 1d8e55d5: outdoor walk, baby sitting low on the hip with legs dangling; too short to judge.
  - Buckle close-ups look fully closed; safety loop not clearly visible.
- Strengths to lean on: listicle format and talking to camera, a photogenic baby who looks happy in the sling, pretty bright home.
- To improve: longer videos (20 to 40s) with her voice; no stairs; show the seat spread knee to knee.
